name: Which drywall finish is best suited for bathroom walls and ceilings?

mainEntity.name: Which drywall finish is best suited for bathroom walls and ceilings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Smooth Level 4 or Level 5 finishes are the preferred standard for bathroom drywall. Heavy textures like knockdown or orange peel create small crevices that trap moisture, dust, and airborne soap residue, making bathroom walls harder to clean and more susceptible to surface mildew. A smooth Level 4 finish is suitable for most walls receiving semi-gloss or satin moisture-resistant paints, while a Level 5 finish involves a full skim coat to hide minor drywall seam variations under critical bathroom vanity lighting.
acceptedAnswer.description: Smooth finishes such as Level 4 or Level 5 are best because they eliminate textured crevices that trap moisture, soap film, and mildew.
